manual.title: Global asset search syntax
manual.description: Combine strict field conditions to search assets. Clicking an example fills the draft without starting a search.
manual.textSemantics: For url, host, title, and responseHeaders, = performs a case-insensitive contains match and == performs a case-sensitive full-field match.
manual.typedSemantics: For statusCode, both = and == perform integer exact matching; for tech, both perform case-sensitive complete-element matching.
manual.urlLimit: URL, host, and title contains values with = require at least 2 Unicode characters
manual.responseHeaderLimit: responseHeaders contains values with = require at least 3 Unicode characters
manual.textLimit: Exact values with == are not subject to the minimum length
manual.conditionLimit: Each query can contain at most 10 conditions
manual.quoting: Values use double quotes and JSON-style backslash escaping
manual.unsupported: !=, parentheses, and unlisted fields are not supported. Use && or the word and when every condition must match, and || or the word or when any condition may match. Do not mix the two in one query.

required.fix: Enter a URL or a field condition such as host="api".

queryTooLong.message: The query exceeds the length limit.
queryTooLong.fix: Shorten it to 2048 UTF-8 bytes or fewer.

invalidField.message: The field name is not valid.
invalidField.fix: Choose url, host, title, statusCode, tech, hasScreenshot, or responseHeaders.

unsupportedField.fix: Use url, host, title, statusCode, tech, hasScreenshot, or responseHeaders.

invalidOperator.fix: Use = or ==. Join conditions with && or the word and, or with || or the word or.

containsValueTooShort.message: The contains value is too short.
containsValueTooShort.fix: Use at least 2 characters for URL, host, and title, or at least 3 characters for responseHeaders.

missingQuotedValue.fix: Use a double-quoted value after the operator, such as tech="nginx".

invalidQuotedValue.message: The quoted value is not valid.
invalidQuotedValue.fix: Use double quotes and JSON-style escaping for special characters.

unterminatedQuotedValue.message: The quoted value is not closed.

invalidConnector.message: The condition connector is not valid.
invalidConnector.fix: Use && or the word and for match-all, or || or the word or for match-any. Do not mix them in one query.

missingCondition.message: A condition is missing after the connector.
missingCondition.fix: Add a complete field condition after &&, and, ||, or or.

tooManyConditions.message: The query has too many conditions.
tooManyConditions.fix: Reduce it to 10 conditions or fewer.

unknown.message: The query could not be parsed.
unknown.fix: Use the supported fields, operators, and double-quoted values from the syntax guide.
